comment: Simple Mobheads: one entry per head (KONZEPT-SIMPLE-MOBHEADS-2026-10-13 §3.6). tools/generate_heads.py turns it into Java, models, loot, tags, lang. tex = path under <ns>:textures/entity without .png (namespace minecraft unless given). model.custom = hand-made geometry of the 16 heads that moved in (look kept); otherwise layer#name + part path ('' = whole model).
